item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Eh, I didn't love this, but I still like the characters and still found it amusing. Something felt missing though. I kind of wish more had happened. This had enough action, but it could stand for a bit more. Be careful to make sure each installment of this series is a story too. Overall, upvoted.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
To be fair, that's exactly what it is. That's totally an intentional thing that is happening. Cori and Paulson are literally straight from Cool War, and represent all the stupid AWCY? that the site at large (and Aldon in-universe, as their sect is what she's been exposed to) despises. And, well, we'll see how that turns out. You're free to still dislike it obviously, just thought I'd drop in and say the AWCY?/anart preconception is definitely a thing I plan to address and hopefully resolve in some capacity as this arc will act as an epilogue of sorts for Cool War.

As for the SCP acronym thing… Well, there's a slight justification coming in the next tale, but… I mean, come on, Kalinin. Did you expect anything more from me?

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Strangely, I think I would have liked this a lot if it were actually the story of two anartists trying to get by. Unfortunately, what this installment actually is, is a story about AWCY recruitment, and now the whole host of AWCY preconceptions (which now seem to be informed primarily by The Cool War series) is invited to the party. Also, no, I can't abide the goofy SCP acronym thing.

The first installment felt fresh and original. This one comes off to me as weighed down by preexisting tropes and increasing site orthodoxy.

item.title: Author Stuff
item.content:encoded:
Continuing off Anart Antics, here's the second installment in the epic story of two anartists trying to get by.

Big thanks to Chubert, Palaios, Randomini, ihp, DjKaktus, TheDeadlyMoose, JConwell, andprobablyotherpeople. Y'all are awesome.

+ There were references! Like, a couple. A few. Whatever, click this for spoilers.
- Spoilers yo
  • There's SCP-092, with permission from Voct. Might be abusing them tunes again somewhere down the line.
  • We also have an origin story for my own SCP-2300! Copper and its new friends Boron are 2300-29 and 2300-5, respectively.
  • Cassandra Paulson amd Felix Cori are both from some other anart tale series.
  • There's Spicy Crust Pizza, which is in some things already.
  • And then there's this little tale, alluded to with the dong cult comment.
